title: Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro and Pad 9 announced
description: Alongside the Xiaomi 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max, which were unveiled in China, the company also launched the Pad 9 Pro and Pad 9 tablets. The new models join the Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max, which debuted earlier this month. The Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro is the larger one with a 12.5-inch LCD display that offers a 144Hz refresh rate and a 3.2K resolution. The tablet is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset, which is paired with up to 12GB of RAM and 256GB of UFS 4.1 storage. It gets a 50MP primary rear camera and a 32MP front camera. The Pad 9 Pro packs a 11,000mAh battery and supports 67W...

title: Realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition unboxing and hands-on
description: After Realme partnered with Warner Bros on the Realme 15 Pro Game of Thrones Edition, it's time for the Realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition! As blockbusters go, these two are not easy to beat. The phone on which this special edition is based is great on its own merit, but it's still the Harry Potter stuff that's more interesting. And there's a lot of that here. For starters everything is packed inside the tiny little Hogwarts school trunk. The phone, an 80W charger, a USB cable, a case, an invitation letter to Hogwarts, bookmarks from each of the four houses - Slytherin, Ravenclaw,...

title: Amazfit's T-Rex Dual Solar smartwatch offers dual-sided solar charging
description: Amazfit has unveiled the T-Rex Dual Solar, a new solar powered smartwatch featuring solar panels on both the front and rear. The dual solar panels can extend battery life when the watch is exposed to sunlight. The Amazfit T-Rex Dual Solar is claimed to offer up to 21 days of typical usage from its built-in 660mAh battery. However, when worn on the wrist and exposed to three hours of direct sunlight each day, the typical battery life can increase to 34 days. Meanwhile, exposing the larger solar panel on the rear to three hours of direct sunlight daily can extend the typical usage...

title: Realme 16 Pro 5G Harry Potter Edition and Buds T500 Pro Harry Potter Edition sold out
description: A couple of days ago, Realme unveiled the 16 Pro 5G Harry Potter Edition and the Realme Buds T500 Pro Harry Potter Edition. People seem to have really liked them, as both products have sold out in the company's online store in India within 24 hours of the launch. If you want either one now, you'll have to go and check offline brick-and-mortar stores hoping you'll be lucky enough to find one which still has stock. The Realme 16 Pro 5G Harry Potter Edition comes with the world's first "quadra light sensing" color changing back cover, with a distinctive design featuring a textured...

title: This US carrier doesn't want to let you use one phone number on two iPhones
description: iPhone Handoff is a new feature in the recently released iOS 27 which lets you use one phone number on two separate iPhones (not at the same time, but still). Over in the US, T-Mobile jumped at the opportunity to be the first carrier to support the feature, and it's priced it at $5 per month. In the meantime, Verizon has confirmed that it will be bringing iPhone Handoff to its customers by the end of the year. That leaves AT&T as the only holdout, and this is intentional. This carrier doesn't seem at all interested in providing the feature to its customers. Here's what an AT&T...

title: Samsung's One UI 9 update for the Galaxy S26 series reaches the US
description: A week ago, Samsung officially announced the rollout of One UI 9 based on Android 17 for the Galaxy S26, Galaxy S26+, and Galaxy S26 Ultra. The update was initially available in South Korea only, but that changes today. The Galaxy S26 trio is now receiving the One UI 9 update in the US as well. The first carrier versions to get it are T-Mobile's. It arrives over-the-air as a 4.1GB download. After installing the update, your phone will be running Android 17 with One UI 9, with the build number ending in "BZID". Now that T-Mobile opened the floodgates, undoubtedly AT&T and Verizon...

title: The pricey 1TB and 2TB iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max found to use very slow memory
description: The iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max last year introduced a 2TB storage tier. Just like them, the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max are available in four configurations: 256GB, 512GB, 1TB and 2TB. Something has changed, however, and it is the type of storage used. In a video on BiliBili, Homolab compared two 18 Pro Max phones, one with 512GB storage and one with 1TB. Apparently, the 256GB and 512GB Pro models use TLC flash – each memory cell fits three bits. However, the 1TB and 2TB models use QLC – four bits per memory cell. QLC is known to be slow, so Apple added a fast SLC cache (one bit per...

title: Apple opens a 600-seat live music venue in London
description: In quite the unexpected move, Apple has opened a 600-seat live music venue in London. It's called the Apple Music Hall and you can find it inside the Battersea Power Station (which is a mall these days, despite the name). Apple says artists can "perform an intimate live show" for fans in the venue, but also record it in Spatial Audio, create a broadcast-ready mix, and capture multi-camera video, all directly from the venue. Apple Music Hall incorporates "heritage brickwork, fluted arches, and bronze balconies reminiscent of the historic oriel windows", thanks to its location. A giant glass...

title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max review
OnePlus 16's AnTuTu score surfaces
description: The AnTuTu team just spotted a OnePlus device with the model number PYB110 in their database. It's powered by the just-unveiled Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 SoC, and the prototype which ran the benchmark had 16GB of RAM and 1TB of storage. The phone also comes with a 185Hz refresh rate. Given these specs, this is clearly the upcoming OnePlus 16. As you can see from the image below, it scored 5,384,433 points in AnTuTu v12. It achieved a CPU score of 1,458,283, a GPU score of 2,010,584, a memory score of 766,362, and a UX score of 1,149,204. Of course this is just a preliminary...

title: Galaxy Tab S12+ and S12 Ultra specs leak - here's what will be upgraded
description: There has been a slow trickle of leaks for the Galaxy Tab S12+ and Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra. Now, WinFuture has fully opened the tap and... not much came out. The Tab S12 slates will change a few things from their predecessors, but the upgrades are pretty sparse. Both tablets will be powered by the Dimensity 9500, which replaces a Dimensity 9400+ on the Tab S11 Ultra and a Dimensity 9300+ on the Tab S10+. Why no “plus” chipset this year? Well, MediaTek never released a 9500+ – there is a Dimensity 9600M, but that doesn’t change enough to get a “plus” tag. There’s also the Dimensity 9600 Pro,...

description: It only took a couple of hours for the first phones with Qualcomm’s new Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chips to go official in China. The Xiaomi 18 Pro is the first Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 phone on the market, while the Xiaomi 18 Pro Max claims dibs on the 8 Elite Extreme variant. Xiaomi 18 Pro (left) and 18 Pro Max (right) Outside of the new flagship chips, the Xiaomi 18 Pro series brings larger batteries, hardware-level privacy displays, updated telephoto cameras, and they retain the rear screens from their predecessors. description: The Galaxy Tab S12+ and Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra are expected to be unveiled on October 7, though Samsung hasn’t confirmed the date yet. title: The Huawei Watch D3 is now available in Europe, comes with a free smart bathroom scale
description: While most smartwatches that purport to measure blood pressure use optical sensors, the Huawei Watch D3 is one of the few that does it right – it has an inflatable airbag cuff integrated into the watch strap and is CE MDR-certified for blood pressure monitoring. Starting today, you can buy one in Europe and you’ll get several freebies along the way too. You can use the Huawei Watch D3 to measure your blood pressure anywhere, anytime The Watch D3 is built for 24/7 blood pressure tracking. title: Motorola unveils Signature 27 with 200MP telephoto camera, Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6
description: Motorola has shared a first look at its upcoming Signature 27 flagship phone during Qualcomm’s Snapdragon Summit keynote. The handset is among the first smartphones to feature the newly announced Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset. Although it is only the second phone in Motorola’s Signature series, the upcoming flagship introduces a new naming convention based on the last two digits of the year it is set to launch, hence the Signature 27. title: The 3D models of foldable phones on our site can now be opened and closed, here's a look
description: For many years now, we’ve been partnered with Binkies 3D to give you access to 3D models of smartphones that you can spin around, zoom in on and explore. But now foldable phones have complicated things a bit. These phones are designed to be used in two configurations – folded and unfolded. Each has its pros and cons and they differ by the form factor. A flip foldable’s cover display may be just enough to answer a quick text, but it’s not great for general use. title: Android OEMs pledge allegiance to the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 series
description: The Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 and 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 are now official, and most of the big names in the Android sphere have already confirmed their next-gen devices with the new chips. Xiaomi is first in line with its 18 series. The 18 Pro will arrive with the standard 8 Elite Gen 6, while the 18 Pro Max will feature the Extreme version of the chip. Both phones will be introduced later today in China. Honor will feature the top-notch 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 in its Magic9 Pro Max, which is launching on September 28. title: Oppo K14 Plus' key specs, launch date, and design revealed
description: Oppo teased the K14 Plus last week, and today it announced that the smartphone will be unveiled in India on September 29 at 12 PM local time. The Oppo K14 Plus will be available through Flipkart as a Flipkart Unique product, with Oppo promising "exciting offers during the Big Billion Days" to customers. A promo page set up on Flipkart reveals the Oppo K14 Plus will come with a MediaTek 7360 Max SoC, a 6.77" 1.5K AMOLED screen with a 144Hz refresh rate and 3,600 nits peak brightness, ColorOS 16, 8GB RAM, and 256GB storage. title: Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 and 8 Elite Gen 6 debut
description: Qualcomm’s latest flagship chipsets are now official. The new Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 and Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 mobile platforms are built on a 2nm process and feature Oryon CPU cores clocked at up to 5.0GHz. The Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 and 8 Elite Gen 6 feature 64 bit Oryon CPUs paired with new Adreno GPUs and Hexagon NPUs. Both chipsets feature two Prime cores clocked at up to 5.0GHz and six Performance cores running at up to 4.0GHz. description: A few days ago, we heard that Samsung was considering using LPDDR5X memory in the Galaxy S27 and S27+ instead of going with LPDDR6. Today, a new rumor from Korea says the company still aims to equip the Galaxy S27 Ultra and S27 Pro with LPDDR6 RAM and UFS 5.1 storage, but there is a possibility that only one or more higher RAM/storage tiers would get that, while the lower ones wouldn't. On the other hand, it seems pretty clear that the S27 and S27+ won't see the new memory and storage standards.
